relationships.description: ISA-95 Part 1 role-based equipment hierarchy (discrete): the machine is a work cell of a production line (core 6.0.0, audit H1; before: ISA-88 ProcessCell).
A machine of a job shop is a work unit of its generic work center (ISA-95 Part 1, the WorkCenter → WorkUnit branch; owner 29.10.2026, X2: the sim names no line for most of its machines).

isa95.grain: one equipment element at equipment level WorkCell (ISA-95 Part 1 role-based equipment hierarchy, discrete production: ProductionLine → WorkCell, as the ISA-95 audit of 13.10.2026 (H1) cites Part 1 5.3.7–5.3.9; B2MML-Common.xsd EquipmentLevel1Type WorkCell; core 6.0.0 — before it the batch branch ProcessCell → Unit): one row = one machine (its specialisations CNC-Machine and InjectionMoldingMachine inherit this grain), keyed by its Equipment ID element_id — the one ID space all levels of the role-based equipment hierarchy share
